mutations.name: LR-NOREAP
mutations._mechanism: skill-candidates exec-pane leak row: the finalizer reports leaks but never kills them; the orphan must survive and the end-to-end test must see it.

mutations.name: LR-NOSCAN
mutations._mechanism: the finalizer never looks: leaked is always empty, so nothing is reported or reaped.

mutations.name: LR-ANCESTRY
mutations._mechanism: drop the ancestry exclusion: the reaper may match its own process tree.
mutations.find: if not pid_text.isdigit() or int(pid_text) in skip:

mutations.name: LR-DENIED-UNWRAPPED
mutations._mechanism: skill-candidates 'declarable sandbox teardown artefact': a denied ps listing escapes find_leaked as a raw PermissionError, so the sandboxed session errors at teardown again.

mutations.name: LR-DENIED-SILENT
mutations._mechanism: the denial is swallowed without the SKIPPED line, so an unchecked run reads like a clean one.

mutations.name: LR-DENIED-NOCAUSE
mutations._mechanism: the wrapper drops its cause, hiding which OS error the sandbox raised.
